Let me break down yesterday's performance by the numbers. We went 1-0 with 100.0% accuracy on October 18th. When you're looking at a perfect slate, that's exactly what you want to see in the data.

## The Rays Pick: A Statistical Winner

Our model gave the Rays a 51% win probability against the Guardians—basically a coin flip with a slight edge. The fact that we hit on a 51% confidence pick shows the model's precision even in tight matchups. This is where data analysis separates from gut feelings.

## Oct 19 Preview: Rays vs Guardians Rematch
